{{Quote|Do you really think I'm so stupid as to walk into your traps, Priest?|[[Alima]], to [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]]|<ref name="The Sand Tender: The Hammerhead's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=The Sand Tender: The Hammerhead's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
The '''arool''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of cactus that was native to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The arool was one of several [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] species on the planet;<ref name="CSWE" /> others included the [[Bafforr tree|bafforr]] and the [[vesuvague tree]]s.<ref name="TEC">''[[The Sand Tender: The Hammerhead's Tale]]''.</ref> The arool was poisonous to [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The arool was created by [[Dave Wolverton]] for the short story ''[[The Sand Tender: The Hammerhead's Tale]]''. It later received entries in the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' ([[1998]]) and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' ([[2008]]), both mistakenly spelled "arrol."
